p10_b0.ocr: In a study involving 33 participants in both the TOE Group and TOC Group, the time to achieve intubation was analyzed, revealing a T1 of 3.7 ± 1.6 seconds for the TOE Group versus 3.4 ± 0.8 seconds for the TOC Group, with a P-value of 0.278. Notably, the T2 times were significantly different, showing 34.9 ± 3.0 seconds for the TOE Group and 27.2 ± 2.5 seconds for the TOC Group, with a P-value of <0.0001.

p10_b1.ocr: The total time to intubation was also markedly different, with the TOE Group at 38.7 ± 3.3 seconds and the TOC Group at 30.6 ± 2.7 seconds, both yielding a P-value of <0.0001. The number of intubation attempts was consistent at 33/0/0 for both groups, and neither group employed the BURP maneuver (0/33). The duration of tracheal operation times was 189.7 ± 92.3 minutes for the TOE Group and 184.8 ± 81.5 minutes for the TOC Group, resulting in a P-value of 0.822.
